prompt: Create a map of Europe in 1914 immediately before the First World War. Show national borders and label the major states, including the German Empire, Austro-Hungarian Empire, Russian Empire, Ottoman Empire, France, United Kingdom, Italy, Serbia, Romania, Bulgaria, Greece, Belgium, and the Netherlands. Distinguish the Triple Entente and Central Powers with a legend.

spec.title: Europe in 1914: Alliances and Borders on the Eve of World War I
spec.subtitle: Political divisions and alliance blocs as of July 28, 1914
notes: Alliance categories represent the situation immediately before the First World War and require editorial review for associated or later belligerents.
spec.referenceSummary: This map depicts the political borders and alliance blocs of Europe on the eve of World War I, using authoritative historical sources for 1914 borders and alliance memberships.

checks.message: 26 mapped countries use Natural Earth 1:50m boundaries.
Every mapped region cites a declared web source.
10 web citations grounded the map specification.
Boundaries are schematic. Editorial review against the cited sources is required before publication.
Historical state boundaries were resolved from the dated CShapes 2.0 catalogue instead of model-generated polygons.
Re-rendered locally after per-ring spherical winding normalization; no additional model call.
